about: Expected events, worked out by hand from SuperCollider's semantics (sclang was not run): EventPatternProxy.play does nothing while its player is playing. Tempo 1 beat per second; degrees 0, 1, 2, 3 of the major scale are MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65; dur 0.5, each note 0.4 beats long. The second routine plays Pdef(\a) at beat 1 (quant 1: it starts at beat 1). The first routine, earlier in the file, plays it at beat 4 and every 8 beats after that, for ever: it is playing each time, so nothing changes. One voice, event k at beat 1 + k / 2, degree k % 4 (at beat 500, event 998: degree 2; at beat 1000, event 1998: degree 2). Exactly one note sounds just after each of the first routine's plays.
